scope: Independent stdlib zipfile/json/Decimal accounting of the two existing official backtest exports; no backtest, strategy change, or consumer comparator imported or executed.

official_export_comparison.method: Parse both complete official JSON members with json.loads(parse_float=Decimal), recursively compare every dict key/list item/scalar with no ignored trade or order fields.
official_export_comparison.excluded_only: These two run-clock timestamps; no other official JSON fields differ. ZIP byte hashes differ as expected because run times and embedded strategy sources differ. Sidecar meta run_id/backtest_start_time are run-specific, not trade results.

decimal_trade_accounting.method: Sum each serialized trade profit_abs using Decimal; enter_tag keys are exact including trailing spaces. Native and modified ledgers are identical. Negative-profit subtotal is already included in net, not an additional expense. Official report totals use pandas floating arithmetic and may differ at insignificant sub-nanounit digits from exact serialized-trade Decimal sums.
decimal_trade_accounting.reconciliation: Six mutually exclusive exact tags sum to 441 trades, 401 wins, 40 losses and 1712 nested orders; official results_per_enter_tag and TOTAL counts/wins/losses agree. The official portfolio profit_total_abs is -59146.010779790005 USDT in both arms; Decimal summing individually serialized values yields -59146.010779790004008 USDT.

five_affected_signal_coverage.overlap: One filled trade has exact tag '166 169 '; membership counts therefore total 442 for 441 distinct trades. All five signals have nonzero engine tag coverage and filled membership; the exact engine row hashes and tagged-candle counts match for all 19 pairs.

closed_trade_drawdown.basis: Official strategy max_drawdown_*: optimize_reports.py:740-762 calls calculate_max_drawdown(results, value_col='profit_abs', starting_balance=start_balance); metrics.py:130-161,207-269 sorts closed trades by close_date and accumulates closed profit.

marked_wallet_balance_drawdown.basis: Official wallet_stats max_drawdown_*: optimize_reports.py:37-121 groups wallet capture values by date, sums rate*balance, calls calculate_max_drawdown_from_balance; this includes wallet valuation and is NOT the closed-trade drawdown or a substitution for it.

provenance.commands: Saved commands use the same pinned Docker image, config.json, read-only market data, timerange 20260101-20260806, --cache none, --export signals, and only arm-specific strategy paths, userdirs, output paths, and container names.

raw_docker_terminal_events.interpretation: Both container engines completed successfully, including modified after SIGTERM during coordinator interruption. Native saved CLI status is PASS/returncode 0; original execution/STATUS.json remains RUNNING, modified CLI returncode is unobserved, and no modified status.json was fabricated.

limitations: Modified coordinator/CLI exit code and final coordinator status are unobserved because the parent tool timed out; Docker die exitCode=0 and complete official export do not reconstruct the missing CLI returncode.

No observer capture-time source/config/data SHA snapshot exists. The frozen launch and post-interruption hashes, archived strategy source, archived config equality, and existing 133-file rehash establish strong logical preservation, not continuous cryptographic proof of every byte while the observer ran.

No rerun, new market-data read/rehash, feather wallet-series recalculation, or pickle decoding was performed; wallet and closed-trade drawdown values here are separately labeled official pinned-report outputs.
